review:
I will never know how many shoes this holds because I couldn't even get it put together. The parts didn't click together like they were supposed to. It was just a mess and I threw it in the trash.

I left feedback prior to this, but made a mistake. That feedback was for another shoe rack.
title: Is supposed to hold a lot of shoes but...

review: We have had this a few years: buyer beware as you can’t move it or touch it once it is in place..the spokes just fall off and pain in the neck to put back in. In fact, more a shoe display than a functional shoe rack. We are looking for a new rack where the spokes can be screwed in place. Yeah easy to assemble, also easy to fall apart.
title: Very weak and spokes fall out if you touch the rack. Not functional

review: Not a sturdy item shoes wont really hold up if they are heavy. The unit wobbles and breaks down. If you are not careful the little plast snaps snap off. Really not worth the money you pay for it, especially the shipping cost. The items should be made of real wood and Metal to stand up to heavy use. Just pay the extra money and get a nice shoe rack this one is not worth the money!
title: its not sturdy its plastic

review: This shoe rack is not worth the money. Arrived ripped and torn in side the box. Whoever packaged this item should have realized this item was in terrible condition. The box was not damaged, just the contents. Do not waste your money.
title: Awful Product

review: This didn’t turn out very well. I wanted something a little different for shoes inside the mudroom. It isn’t sturdy and keeps collapsing. Will try something else.
title: Not so much!

review: This rack is ultra lightweight but ultra unsteady. It's really not worth it as a shoe rack. I'd like to find something else. This rack won't be holding up very long.
title: Pretty Unsturdy

review: I needed something small we could put on our entryway table for time check as we are getting ready to leave the house. This is very small, but still bright enough to be seeable. It was easy to set up and I am content with it. The gray wood grain applied to the exterior is not the best, I have some concerns about how long it's going to hold up, but for now I am happy with it.
title: Easy to Set Up

review: we didn’t want a full hall tree in our small city apartment, we hang all our coats AND bags on this and it is doing a great job. 4 stars because the price is a bit too high for the size and function, but otherwise happy
title: Simple & sturdy

review: Be aware that this 3 shelf rack is a different length than the same 5 tier model. That is if you wanted to stack this one on top of the 5 shelf model like I did. You'll be out of luck. It's my fault for not paying attention to the dimensions. It's a great shoe rack though. Dead simple to put together, light but sturdy, and looks very nice as well.
title: Not stackable with the 5 tier rack

review:
This is huge and offers LOTS of space to store your shoes, etc. We are using this in the mudroom as a catchall for shoes and "outside stuff". Plenty of room and fairly sturdy.
You may want to anchor it to the wall if you are putting a lot of heavy stuff on it.
Assembly was easy, if not tedious. It comes as a large box of tubes and shelves pretty much.
Great for massive storage, which is exactly what I was hoping for
title: Lots of storage options with this rack!

review: Not quite as thick/ heavy as I hoped, so it moves around a bit on the carpet, but otherwise it's good and functional. Just the right size for my aprtment entryway in the common area.
title: Functional

review: A shelf got lost along the way, but this is operating just fine as a four shelf shoe as we have boots that fit nicely on the top tier. This was all kinds of fun to assemble - lots of parts, but a useful set of instructions came with it which made the job fairly easy. The finished product is strong and sturdy - lightweight to move around. Works well for shoes
title: Ours is a four tier shoe rack

review: It's a nice frame. Looks good in an entryway. The photos that are in it are not that fabulous but it looked a lot better with my own photos in it.
title: Nice for an entryway

review: This is absolutely perfect! We're using it as an entry table. The unit arrived fully assembled and the quality is very good. I included a photo of it in real life. :-) It's a nice break from all the furniture we've had to assemble! It was a huge plus that this was on sale.
title: Unique and sturdy!

review: These are the best stackable shelf units I have ever purchased. I am using them as a shoe rack. They don't require any tools and are up in seconds. I only purchased one set as I planned to use them for shoes in my closet. However, I would not hesitate in ordering more of these whenever I need a reliable, sturdy stacking shelf unit. They come in a flat box and were well shipped. The barred shelf pieces "snap" onto the rectangle "leg" pieces and are remarkably strong. If you are used to the flimsy, throw-away shoe racks of the old days, you will be most pleasantly surprised. Highly recommended.
title: very sturdy

review: Always have piles of shoes scattered in the garage floor. I am having a similar shoe rack, but that cannot hold all our shoes. I did some research, and found this one. It arrived on time and as I expected, it does its job. I feel great about this purchase!
title: A very good shoe rack, does its job!

review: Nice light-weight but sturdy shoe rack. Very easy to put together and good for small space storage. Good find.
title: Easy Setup

review: We love this coat rack! We are using it in our bathroom behind the door so the folding hooks are very convenient. Only thing was when we went to install the grommet went right through the wall so I had to use other ones I had at the house.
title: Great!

review: My daughter needed a new mirror for her entry. This one is larger than her previous one. She's renting an apartment and can't install it to the wall, so she keeps it on an entry table and leans it against the wall. It says the glass is shatterproof, which is good, though we haven't tested that out! lol. The mirror has a simple design, which goes with the room's aesthetics.
title: Great Mirror

review: This coat rack is very easy to put together. I love the hooks. They really do give the feeling of leaves! The unit is very stable and sturdy. I am very pleased with it.
title: Easy to Put Together

review: This is an awesome shoe rack. It comes in pieces and some assembly is required. Putting it together was simple. The rack easily adjusts in size. I have it at the maximum width and it fits in the space almost perfectly. It's sturdy and doesn't wobble. There's a little room left on it, so I may need to go on a shoe shopping trip soon!
title: Awesome Shoe Rack

review: Color is a bit less grey in person, but overall a nice piece of furniture that arrived in perfect condition. Was quick and easy to assemble. Looks nice in entryway and versatile to use as additional seating when needed.
title: Nice bench

review: I wish I had thought to get this gem years ago. We didn't need all 10 shelves in one location so split it between 2 entryways and it's great!! Light, yet sturdy, and easy to assemble. You won't be disappointed.
title: This is sturdier than it looks!

review:
I purchased a few of these for holiday decorations. At first I thought they were cheesy and cheap looking until I separated the branches and now I love them so much that I am using them after holidays as well!

Two of these fun little trees are now sitting in hall entry table and are perfect nightlights that keep entry and stairs lit up for both family and pets. Definitely recommend these!
title: Perfect to use all year!

review: This bench replaced a couple of plastic shoe racks that we had in our mudroom. This is a great little piece of furniture to keep you organized and has a nice look to it and is very sturdy. I never write reviews on Amazon, just too busy! I had to take the time to write a review and submit a couple pictures as even the description didn’t do this nice piece of furniture justice. I’m very happy with this purchase the quality and the price!
title: Great Mudroom bench!

review: I love this shoe rack!! Fits in my closet perfectly. I have large feet (size 9) and my shoes fit well. The boots only fit on the top though. Great quality and craftsmanship. Great deal! I highly recommend.
title: Great Purchase

review: I am very happy with this rack, I bought it to hold my purses and it is doing an excellent job.
title: Great coat rack.....

review: I needed another shoe rack or a new house so went with this. A solid piece of furniture and beautiful to boot. Could easily be used for other things in your house. I'm a 5-6 shoe so was able to put 15 pairs of shoes on rack. Boots only on top though as bottom 2 racks will only hold teni shoe like shoes.
title: Great piece of furniture

review: Ordered this product for my office, looks great and was a great price that we ordered another one. I would recommend this product.
title: Coat Rack

review: Only fits like 2 pairs of adult boots, could fit more kids. I put in the bottom of mudroom closet for boots. As they are individual closet/stalls for each person there isn't much room so these fit and keeps boots from dirtying up the white cabinet bottom of the closet.
title: Mudroom Closet

review: Nice shoe rack for the money. Low profile for the bottom of the closet but holds a lot!
title: Excellent shoe rack

review: This a nice bench for the money. I am not sure why it's a shoe bench but I have it in my bathroom.
title: Nice bench.

review: This coat rack is made from beautiful wood. Easy to put together. Good balance and stability.
title: Five Stars

review: I just moved to a new home and in need of a entryway table for my foyer. This table is perfect! It’s in good size and I love that there’s a outlet that I can charge my electronic devices. The design is very nice and classic. I love the color very much and it’s very easy to assemble and it’s lightweight too!
title: Great entryway table

review: "This is the most sturdiest shoe rack I have ever owned! It was so awesome, that the shoes went back to the old shoe rack and I am using it as a storage shelf. So now, I have found so many uses for it, that I really need to purchase a couple more!"
title: Love it!

review: This is a great shoe rack! I am not great at figuring out how to put things together and do try to avoid it if possible. However, this product went together easily! It looks great, is sturdy and really helps to organize my shoes.
title: Great shoe rack!

review: This cabinet was for our back entryway as a place to store all our shoes. It looks so nice to have them all stored away and available for use.
title: Perfect solution

review:
To rule the world, a girl needs shoes,
but if you're short on space -
for every one of these you own
two shoes fit in one place!
So, if your shoe rack's looking full
A brief word to the wise
just get a couple sets o' Slotz
to space economize
title: Shoe Slotz make lotsa new shoe space

review: My mudroom is a little staircase landing, and I didn't want anyone taking a digger into a coat hook and losing an eye. This way you get maximum clearance when they're folded up, and if one is extended, it's at least padded with a coat. They're quite sturdy and attractive.
title: Great for a tight hallway

review: This is so easy to hang & discreet! I can pile quite a few things on it & it’s not failed me yet!
title: Great coat rack

review: I like this 10 Tiers Tall Narrow Shoe Rack, It is a Versatile Rack. I like that it is a Metal Shoe Rack. It is very strong. I recommend my friend. I hope you always win. Thank you. God bless you. If this was helpful for you, please check helpful. Below. May the rest of your life, be the best of your life. OZ
title: Goes together EZ

review: [[VIDEOID:4f4d14a03d41de4e1ead2cad43fefa8c]] Love the color black and the real wood. Very study and doesn’t shake. Looks great after many months of use. Maybe the last shoe rack you will ever need.
title: Great solid wood has held up now for months and still looks like new!

review: Easy to assemble and looks really nice! Very sturdy hall tree! We love it so much and highly recommend it!
title: Nice!

review:
This three tier show rack is absolutely perfect in our entry. It fit like a dream and was so easy to put together. It went together with just the tools included with one person in 15 minutes. It does have a little wiggle if you sit on it like a bench while putting on shoes.

The brown is pretty dark but it fits our decor well. We are very happy with this little shoe rack! It’s a great value for the price.
title: Nice little show rack for entryway

review: Fantastic quality item. Very easy to assemble. heavy with a sturdy base. What I like the best are the large knobs at the end of the hangers. They are great for keeping your coats right where you put them. Nothing falls off. Very, very happy with this and it is already in use in my house.
title: Best Coat Rack Ever!

review: What an ingenious and adorable invention. I stuck this in my entryway where there is always an inevitable catch-all area. This magnet helps clear the clutter a little and looks super cute. I have hung 3 key rings on it at once- it was sturdy and there was plenty of room "on the cloud". If I ever have to move it, I don't know if the peel and stuck tab will remain sticky, but figured I could use a 3M peel and stick if needed with no problem. A pretty good $7 investment!
title: Great little invention that I used everyday!

review: Love this shoe rack! It was put together in about 10 minutes or so, and is very sturdy! No wobbling or creaking. 10/10!
title: Super cute and easy to assemble!!❤️

review: These coat hooks are great! They are heavy duty and can hold up to 40 lbs. of weight. They are super easy to install and everything came individually wrapped. You can use for coats, towels, bags, and so much more!
title: Easy to install and very heavy duty!

review: These were great decor for my entryway. They started the party off giving a festive feel
title: Fabulous

review:
This shoe rack is sturdy, attractive and low-profile. Simple to assemble, took 10 minutes. (Easier to look at the picture for guidance, than the instructions.)
I like it so much, I have ordered a second one.
title: Sturdy, attractive & low-profile

review: I recently bought a hall tree that is very large and has 10 hooks. The hall tree came with silver hooks which just don't go with my decor. I found this pack of 11 that is perfect for the swap out. Easy to install and perfect replacement. Good find.
title: Just the right hooks

review: This works great for us in the mudroom where the pets are fed - we can keep everything needed for them in one place. It looks great - it was easy to put together, and the drawers are sturdy enough to hold whatever we need. We were looking for something for a small space, and this fills the bill!
title: Very useful

review: Easy to put together - looks like a giant saguaro cactus when finished! Six “arms” to hold coats - this would look good anywhere - by the front door - in a bedroom, etc. Nice wood finish and it’s very sturdy when complete. Good choice.
title: Great coat rack

review: These will be hung over the washer and dryer to hold the items we use the most. Our laundry is also a mudroom, so we like items that stay with our farmhouse decor. These look great, were easy to put up and work the way we hoped. Delivery was fast, and they arrived in excellent condition. Good choice!
title: Well-built shelves

review: Perfect for an entryway - the mudroom - anywhere you need a way to hang coats, rain gear, sweaters, etc. We particularly like these because they are rustic-appearing - but not as heavy as wrought iron would be. So, they’re easy to put up and really add something to our farmhouse decor. Good choice!
title: Great sturdy hooks!

review: During the spring, we really felt the need for positioning coat hooks everywhere - everybody that came in needed top hang something, and our coat closet couldn’t keep up with it! This is a good-looking, very sturdy set of coat hooks - it’ll hold the heaviest ones. Goes with our farmhouse decor, too.
title: Easy in install, great for coat closet overflow!

review: We have big closets, so this shoe rack was just what we needed to keep all my daughter’s shoes off the floor. Very pleased with this shoe rack. Easy to assemble and lightweight to move around.
title: Perfect rack for shoes.

review:
This coat rack for the price I can imagine is good, and even if it is wobbly...... for the price. But, the description states that it is sturdy. Not sturdy. I will put something on the base to secure it more. And, good that there is a nice, large round base.

But, this is great for children's reach. Some of the hooks can be lower placed so the little ones can reach it. And, there are plenty of hooks. So, other than being wobbly, it is good for use by all!
title: ON THE WOBBLY SIDE!

review: My husband has lots of hats. They took up all the room on the coat rack. I bought him a behind the door rack for his belts and hats, but he just wouldn't put the hats on it. Then I noticed he was putting the hats on top of his lamp in our bedroom. That was the final straw for me. LOL. I ordered this for him. Now his hats are safe but also out of the way. He hung it up in the closet. It is lightweight and sturdy. Works as it should.
title: Great gift

review: This mirror looks great in my spare/guestroom! The first one I received was in pieces, however, the company has great customer service and replaced it. The second one was delivered without incident. It is large and has a thin black casing/trim. I am extremely pleased and have received several complements. I’d recommend this mirror. It would look great in an entryway, bedroom and living room.
title: What a beautiful, large, round mirror.

review: I received this product and originally thought it was flimsy. After putting everything together and using a rubber mallet to help lock connections in place it is sturdy. Love it. Makes my shoes look neat and easy to access.
title: Nice shoe rack

review: Put this in my garage entryway to hold leashes, hats and masks. Pleasantly surprised by quality and appearance. Now own three of them. Great value for the $
title: Great value for the $

review:
This looks good.

The pictures in the listing got my attention for the multiple storage areas. This could well I thought in a closet or even outside of one in a mud room, as a a shoe rack and place to hang jackets
title: Looks good

review: I bought this for my super messy mudroom. I needed a quick and easy way to deal with the clutter of all of the jackets and shoes. It has 2 rows of hooks for coats, hats, and scarves. It also has 3 shelves for shoes or bags. I really appreciate the slotted design for the shelves because it allows air to circulate around wet boots. I was a little concerned that it would not be able to handle the weight of my husband's steel toed work boots, but it holds 2 pair and the kids shoes without a problem.
title: Easy to assemble

review: This is a sturdy and easy to assemble coat rack. Replaces a coat rack that we had for only a year and turned out to be not so sturdy. I recommend this one for the price.
title: This is a sturdy and easy to assemble coat rack
